title: Persistence and Self-Regulation
learningOutcomes: Understand the key ideas behind persistence and self regulation and why this topic matters for child development.
Learn practical skills and strategies that help apply persistence and self regulation in everyday parenting situations.
Build confidence using persistence and self regulation to support connection, safety, and positive family routines.

modules.title: Understanding the Topic
modules.description: Learn what persistence and self regulation means and why it matters for child development.

modules.title: Core Skills and Strategies
modules.description: Explore practical skills and strategies for applying persistence and self regulation in everyday parenting.

modules.title: Real-Life Application
modules.description: See how persistence and self regulation works in real situations with examples and simple scripts.

modules.title: Reflection and Integration
modules.description: Reflect on your learning and plan how to use persistence and self regulation in daily family life.

caseworkerSummary: This topic helps parents build practical skills related to persistence and self regulation. It supports safer, more consistent caregiving by improving understanding, strengthening emotional connection, and reducing stress in daily routines. This topic is suitable for parents who need guidance in applying positive parenting strategies and may benefit families working toward stability, reunification, or improved home safety.
